No profiles whatsoever. So I readjusted my preferences as the application suggested, to try and find more profiles available. No such thing, no profiles. I disputed the charges twice and got denied both times! The creators of this app or whoever runs it, are absolute scam artist. Do not sign up unless you want to be screwed like me! now I have to dispute it with my credit card company. Hopefully this will save somebody from having a complete and total headache and heartache finding out that this app basically a scam and have absolutely no intention on finding you a soulmate or a match. It is strictly designed to create revenue for them. Unfortunately, it also creates an adversarial relationship, between the customer and the company, that’s what it did for me! I will never pay for this app again. Also, this does not look good for apple inc - company, if they’re sponsoring applications-like this on their App Store. Not a good idea! reviews.title: No free element
reviews.text: I understand that they need to make money, but you can barely use the app at all without subscribing, and it’s expensive imo. If you want users to pay, you need to at least give them a go at using the app for free first, how do I know it’ll be worth the money otherwise? Also it almost immediately asked me to rate 5 stars so I could get more matches… so take the ratings on this app with a huge pinch of salt. Not to mention, I set my radius to 60km, and only had about 10 swipes before it ran out, I wonder why there aren’t many active users…
